headline: No experience
required.
hero.lede: We hire first years. We hire people who have never touched a rocket. We hire people who aren't in engineering. Come ready to learn. We'll teach the rest.

cta.headline: We hire first years.
cta.body: We hire people who have never touched a rocket. Come ready to learn. We'll teach the rest.
cta.fine: Find us at Facultyfest on August 31, 12:30 to 17:00, or Clubsfest on September 14, 16:30 to 19:30 on the JHE field. Applications close September 18. You don't need to be an engineer: we need people on operations as much as on airframe.

recruitCta.headline: Want to learn more?
recruitCta.body: Facultyfest August 31, or Clubsfest September 14 on the JHE field. Come talk with the team.

howItWorks.headline: Four steps.
howItWorks.lede: Meet us at Clubsfest or Facultyfest, fill in the form, then have a short interview with the subteam you want to join.

dates.headline: When.
dates.lede: We hire during a set window each term, at Clubsfest and Facultyfest, not on a rolling basis. If you missed the window, email us and we'll get back if there are any openings.

faq.headline: Questions people ask.
faq.lede: If your question isn't here, email us. We would rather answer it than have you talk yourself out of applying.

steps.title: Meet us at Clubsfest or Facultyfest
steps.body: Facultyfest is August 31, 12:30 to 17:00, for incoming first-year engineers. Clubsfest is September 14, 16:30 to 19:30 on the JHE field during B2S week.

steps.title: Fill in the form
steps.body: It asks which subteam you're interested in, plus a few short questions about why you want to join and any past experience.

steps.title: Interview with a subteam
steps.body: Every subteam runs its own interview, usually 30 minutes to an hour, about what you'd want to work on.

steps.title: Start building
steps.body: You're in. Show up to meetings, come to build sessions, and get to work on a real vehicle.

faq.q: I have never built anything. Can I still join?
faq.a: Yes, and most of us started there. First-term members are paired with someone who has done the job before, and your first deliverable is deliberately small. The team exists to teach this.

faq.q: I am not in engineering. Is there a place for me?
faq.a: Yes. Operations is a full subteam: it runs sponsorship, the budget, and everything we do on campus. Commerce, communications, humanities and science students all sit on it. Payload also takes science students most years.

faq.q: How much time does it actually take?
faq.a: About six hours a week for most members.

faq.q: Can I join partway through the year?
faq.a: Not usually. We hire during a set window each term, at Clubsfest and Facultyfest, rather than on a rolling basis. If you missed the window, email us and we'll get back if there are any openings.

faq.q: What if I want to try a different subteam later?
faq.a: Normal, and encouraged. Plenty of people move once they have seen what the other subteams actually do.
